_comment: One row per task category. Each tier is an ordered list of {model, effort}. route() picks the first entry of the tier, or a same-provider entry in a higher tier when that provider has surplus quota. If the pick's account is blocked, route() tries the rest of the tier, then lower tiers, then higher tiers. bmo: and local: entries are never used as a fallback. When bmo is not available, route() skips tier0 if tier0 has a bmo: entry.
